products.description_en: Full teak frame with storage under the mattress, carved headboard and matching side table.

products.description_en: Solid teak with hand-carved headboard and footboard panels, high-gloss polish.

products.description_en: Solid teak frames with slatted backs, built to take cushions in your choice of fabric.
products.description_te: ఘన టేకు ఫ్రేమ్, స్లాట్ బ్యాక్, మీరు ఎంచుకున్న ఫ్యాబ్రిక్ కుషన్లకు సిద్ధం.

products.description_en: 3+1+1 frames under construction in our workshop, shaped arms and turned detail.

products.description_en: Carved teak seat with shankha, chakra and namam panel, for temples and pooja rooms.

products.description_en: Heavy carved frame and floral panels with a Ganesha top panel in solid teak.

products.description_en: Six-panel double door with carved top panel, fitted with frame.
